title: Lessons from a Can Opener
summary: Technology Connections spends 22 minutes on the humble can opener and what its design shows about products and why people don't know what to look for. It uses an everyday tool to draw broader lessons.
why: It gets mentioned as a thought-provoking video that changes how you look at everyday objects, though HN mentions are sparse.

quote.text: it's made me actually think about can openers a bit now. You might find it interesting, too.
